full.title: WARMUP • 10 MIN
full.body:
2 rounds at an unhurried pace:
90 seconds easy row or bike
8 glute bridges with a 2-second squeeze
8 dead bugs per side
8 empty-bar Romanian deadlifts
Finish with 3 gradual sets of Deadlift

full.title: STRENGTH
full.body:
Deadlift
3 × 5 at 55%

Move with consistent technique; no missed repetitions.

full.title: ACCESSORY • OPTIONAL
full.body: 2 sets: 8 low box step-ups per side

full.body:
Intervals

15-minute row interval session:
0:30 powerful but technically smooth rowing
0:30 very easy rowing
